ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels account for approximately 5-8% of the surface area, while low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels account for 92-95%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark low-intensity base across entire fluke. High-intensity circular focal points scattered across both lobes. Contiguous high-contrast white blobs are localized at the distal tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most extreme at the distal tips, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature extending from the central median notch to the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous white circular pixel clusters (barnacles) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, with heavy density at the outer margins and tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal and oblique linear pixel disruptions visible on the interior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated calcified scarring at the terminal distal tips of both lobes; significant jagged erosion along the outer trailing edge.
